headline: THREE TANKERS
HIT NEAR HORMUZ
leads.story: Projectiles hit two tankers leaving the Gulf. Iran says a third ship struck a mine east of the strait.

headline: COP31 SPLITS
ON FOSSIL FUELS
leads.story: The EU and Pacific islands press for fossil fuel cuts. African negotiators seek more money for adaptation.

headline: RIEMANN PROOF
PASSES CHECKS
leads.story: Independent tools verify the Lean proof of a conjecture about prime numbers first posed in 1859.
